title: Legacy model variant: grace window, compatibility assistance, and migration playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We have several older model versions (legacy variants) still in the model catalog that are functionally compatible but cause higher latency/cost and block downstream optimizations (kernel/quantization). We need a repeatable, low-friction workflow to retire these legacy model versions while minimizing customer disruption.

Goal: Define an operational deprecation workflow that includes: a clear grace window, signals to detect pinned customers, prioritized migration assistance (top pinned customers), published migration guides and compatibility notes, console/SDK notices, and a runbook for rollout, rollback, and post-sunset telemetry. The workflow must be automatable where possible and integrate with performance profile publishing so customers can pick appropriate alternatives.

Out of scope: Global policy for forced deletion of customer data, changes to licensing model, or platform pricing adjustments. This ticket focuses on the communication + migration mechanics and tools for customers who pin to older variants.
acceptance_criteria: Console displays a non-dismissible banner for affected customers 90 days before sunset with links to migration guide
Migration guide published in Docs with code snippets for SDKs, pinning/unpinning instructions, and performance profile comparisons
Automated telemetry can surface top 25 accounts by request-volume pinned to the legacy variant
A small migration-assist offer template exists for customer success (email + dedicated ticket playbook)
A one-click rollout helper (script) that applies a compatibility shim or updated prompt template is documented and verified in staging
Close-loop metrics: % pinned customers migrated within grace window, error rate delta post-migration, and cost-per-token improvement tracked
tasks: Write migration guide draft (Docs) with code examples for JavaScript, Python, and cURL
Design console banner copy and link target (UX) and place mock in Figma
Build telemetry query to list pinned customers and weekly snapshot export
Create migration-assist email and CS playbook templates
Engineer: small compatibility shim (runtime flag) proof-of-concept and one-click script
Legal/Support: confirm retention/notification requirements for regulated accounts
Run a pilot migration with 3 low-risk customers and capture learnings
